slides.title: Rights group urges Ethiopia to lift newspaper ban
Protect press freedom. Protect civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

card.title: “Ongoing assault on the media and civic space”
card.body: Human Rights Watch, on the indefinite suspension of The Reporter, the country's last privately owned Amharic newspaper. HRW urged authorities to reverse it and international partners to press them to do so.
